name: Arize Phoenix
description: OpenTelemetry-based LLM tracing and evaluation, licensed under ELv2.
descriptionZh: 基于 OpenTelemetry 的 LLM 追踪与评测，采用 ELv2 许可。
keyFact: Arize Phoenix is a self-hostable LLM tracing and evaluation tool first released on 26 April 2023, built on OpenTelemetry and OpenInference; it is licensed under Elastic License 2.0 rather than Apache-2.0 or MIT, which permits free self-hosting but forbids reselling it as a competing hosted service.
keyFactZh: Arize Phoenix 是 2023 年 4 月 26 日首次发布的可自托管 LLM 追踪与评测工具，构建于 OpenTelemetry 与 OpenInference 之上；其许可为 Elastic License 2.0（而非 Apache-2.0 或 MIT），允许免费自托管，但禁止将其作为竞争性托管服务转售。
caveat: Sometimes mislabelled as Apache-2.0; the actual license is Elastic License 2.0, which is source-available rather than OSI open source.
caveatZh: 常被误标为 Apache-2.0，实际许可为 Elastic License 2.0，属 source-available 而非 OSI 开源。
